name: Druid
description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.
starting_equipment: Wooden Shield or any Simple Weapon
Scimitar or any Simple Melee Weapon
Leather Armor, Explorer's Pack, and Druidic Focus

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells.

features.name: Primal Order
features.description: At 1st level, you choose a primal order that shapes how you channel your connection to nature. Choose Magician or Warden.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your bonus action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you know. You can use this feature a number of times based on your druid level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). At 2nd level, you know 4 forms and can transform into beasts with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: At 2nd level, you can summon a nature spirit that takes an animal form. This works like the Find Familiar spell, but you don't need material components. The familiar is a fey instead of a beast.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: At 3rd level, you choose to identify with a circle of druids. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can now transform into beasts with CR 1/2 or lower. You know 6 forms instead of 4.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Druid Circle Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Druid Circle.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can now transform into beasts with CR 1 or lower. You know 8 forms instead of 6. You can now transform into beasts that have a flying speed.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Druid Circle Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Druid Circle.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Druid Circle Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Druid Circle.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: At 20th level, you can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times. Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic.

2.name: Bonus Cantrip
2.description: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

2.name: Natural Recovery
2.description: You can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
